acceptance: A redeploy run fetches the bundle by the deployed receipt's core_sha and fails closed unless the fetched digest equals the receipt's bundle_digest
When no receipt is deployed for the target, redeploy fails with a named error instead of picking the newest bundle
Tests cover a matching digest, a digest mismatch and no deployed receipt
deploy/README.md and the workflow input description say what redeploy ships
description: The Deploy workflow's 'redeploy (same bundle again)' mode (.github/workflows/deploy.yml:11) fetches the newest successful site-inputs bundle by run creation time (scripts/bundle-fetch.mjs:88-96), and redeploy skips the freshness compare (deploy/cli.ts:114 runs it only in deploy mode). A redeploy can therefore ship a core bundle older than the live one, or a newer one that never passed the freshness check, contrary to its label. The deployed receipt records core_sha and bundle_digest, and bundle-fetch accepts SITE_INPUTS_CORE_SHA (bundle-fetch.mjs:80-87; SITE_INPUTS_RUN_ID takes precedence at :73 and must be cleared). The superseded-bundle item adds a fetch-by-deployed-core_sha path with a digest check; reuse it.
